blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fishers’ group Pambansang Lakas ng Kilusang Mamamalakaya ng Pilipinas (Pamalakaya) has asked the Commission on Human Rights (CHR) to investigate the alleged harassment and intimidation of its members in Manila Bay by individuals who reportedly identified themselves as personnel of the Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity (OPAPRU). OPAPRU, however, denied the allegations, saying the person who identified himself as OPAPRU personnel is not employed by or affiliated with the agency.
